author: Dmitrii Roshchenko behind Codex (tasks)
features: Settings / AI providers: administrator-only embeddings and Jev configuration, enable/disable, key replacement/removal and synthetic connection probes
Encrypted credential persistence, environment defaults, optimistic editor revisions and immediate backend configuration updates
Settings / Knowledge & indexing: project selection, existing repository sources, wiki paths, Graphify export upload or checkout path, manual/automatic refresh and context preview
Task embedding coverage, background indexing, rebuild, progress and cancellation
Project-scoped knowledge in tasks_prepare, tasks_search_context and Jev request fingerprints; stale sources are excluded

verification.isolated_postgresql_18: Passed the legacy migration/atomic workflow integration test, extended with encrypted settings persistence and restoration

limits: Live embeddings/Jev provider verification awaits administrator credentials. Browser provider responses and keys were synthetic; no production task was evaluated by an external model.
Wiki and Graphify retrieval uses text/symbol matching; task embeddings are a separate index.
Graphify is imported as data, not executed by the server. An export from a different source commit is shown as stale and excluded from retrieval.
The existing Dioxus CLI 0.7.9 reports a warning for the locked Dioxus 0.7.10 dependency; release builds and browser verification pass with this repository's deployment toolchain.
Goals filter changes were cancelled and are absent from this implementation.
